baseline-authz: Identity, ownership or sharing differences; valid business controls.
flow-chain: Accepted request, background stages and final delivery are separate events.
static-dynamic-retest: Source/runtime disagreement or a changed request, policy or deployment.
observer-validity: Enumeration, timing or size differences with questionable controls.
controller-reach: Ambiguous filter, routing, validation or handler response.
capability-consumer: Recognized or issued credential with an unproven final consumer.
protocol-binding: Challenge, principal, origin or credential-to-consumer binding.
patch-differential: Fix claims, feature toggles or rollout differences across deployments.
authorization-context: Effective token scope, operation policy or authorization-matrix outlier.
evidence-linkage: Static claims, runtime effects or fingerprints lacking causal linkage.
asset-attribution: Discovery candidates, DNS/CT, ownership, deployment or CVE applicability.
impact-assessment: Observed capability, affected object, actual result and chain prerequisites.
hypothesis-lifecycle: Conditional negative results, reopening or correcting a prior conclusion.
